mechanism_notes: Canonical CARLA jerk uses DecelMeter gated/clamped speed-drop ego_a; whole-series Butterworth forward/backward 6th-order per pass at 10 Hz; RMS finite differences from the T_AEB index through run end at recorded fixed_delta_seconds. T_AEB uses the last -1 m/s^2 crossing traced back to -0.3 m/s^2; not raw IMU/GT jerk
Diagnostic GT jerk is stored in report.braking with its own recorder clock, raw signal, window and duration weighting
limitations: Calibration membership, measured response and causal attribution are separate claims
